title: Lasguy's 2x2 Trees
description: 2×2 tree farming for oak, birch, acacia & cherry—more wood via configurable bonemeal or bone-block drop. Great with Timber or Treecapitator!
body:
Lasguy’s 2x2 Trees — Description

Want way more wood without ugly megaspruce everywhere? This pack adds 2×2 variants for oak, birch, acacia, and cherry—purpose-built for tree farming, not aesthetics.

How to use

Plant: place a 2×2 of the same sapling type (oak/birch/acacia/cherry).

Grow (two modes):

Bonemeal Mode (default): hit any sapling in the 2×2 with bonemeal 4 times within ~5s. I reccommend bonemealing each sapling 1x to prevent accidental vanilla trees.

Bone Block Mode: drop a bone block onto the 2×2. (It consumes the dropped item; if you drop a stack, the whole stack is used—drop one!)

Configure (in-game menu)

Run: /function las2x2:menu

Toggle Mode: Bonemeal ⇄ Bone Block.

Bonemeal Uses Required: set 1–10 (default 4).

Menu auto-refreshes after each click so you see the new value right away.

Note: opening the menu requires permission to run /function (singleplayer with cheats ON or server op). After you set it, players just farm as usual.

Install

Drop the zip in your world’s datapacks/ folder → /reload. That’s it.

Built for minecraft 1.21.x; no “made for older version” nag, tiny footprint, no resource pack needed.

Tips & gotchas

Make sure the 2×2 is all the same species and has enough space (logs/leaves need room or it just won’t grow, kind of obvious but still).

In Bone Block mode, the exact item that triggered growth is consumed; if you don’t want to lose a stack, toss a single block.

Plays nice with popular farming packs; if something seems off, reload the world and re-open the menu—usually clears it up.

That’s basically it—simple, fast, and great for stocking up on planks… a lot of planks.
